meta.description: Misconception remediation paths for Unit 3 practice MCQs

ammeter_parallel_error.feedback: An ammeter must be in series so the full circuit current passes through it.

series_parallel_resistance_swap.feedback: Series: resistances add (R1+R2). Parallel: add reciprocals (1/Rp = 1/R1+1/R2).

power_energy_confusion.feedback: Power (W) is rate; energy (J or kWh) is power × time.
power_energy_confusion.calm_prompt: W vs kWh — rate vs total.
